_note: Each answer is graded by whether the reply contains every 'expect' value (commas removed, case-insensitive). 'any' lists accepted alternatives.

hard.q: A warehouse has 1240 boxes. Each pallet holds 36 boxes. How many full pallets can be built, and how many boxes are left over?
A store sold product A at $12 for 45 units, product B at $7.50 for 80 units and product C at $20 for 12 units. What is the total revenue in dollars?
A train leaves at 9:40 and travels 255 km at 85 km/h without stopping. At what time does it arrive?
Inventory starts at 2000 units and drops 15% each month. How many units are left after 3 months, rounded to a whole number?
A worker packs 14 orders per hour for 7.5 hours, then 9 orders per hour for 2 hours. How many orders in total?
An item costs $80. It is discounted by 25%, then 10% tax is added to the discounted price. What is the final price in dollars?
One picker finishes a route in 30 minutes and another in 45 minutes. Working together on the same route, how many minutes does it take?
What is the probability of rolling two sixes with two fair dice? Give it as a fraction.
What number comes next in the sequence 3, 7, 15, 31?
A shelf is 240 cm long. Boxes are 30 cm wide and need a 5 cm gap between neighbouring boxes, with no gap at the ends. What is the maximum number of boxes?
If $1000 earns 5% interest per year, compounded annually, how much is it worth after 3 years? Round to the cent.
If 5 machines make 5 widgets in 5 minutes, how many minutes do 100 machines need to make 100 widgets?
A bat and a ball cost $1.10 together. The bat costs $1.00 more than the ball. How much does the ball cost in dollars?
What is the average of 12, 15, 21, 30 and 47?
A truck can carry 9000 kg. Two pallets of 1100 kg are already loaded. How many more pallets of 640 kg can it take?
Convert 72 km/h to metres per second.
A clock shows 3:15. What is the angle between the hour and minute hands in degrees?
One supplier delivers every 6 days and another every 8 days. Both delivered today. In how many days will they both deliver on the same day again?
A rectangle has a perimeter of 46 m and its length is 5 m more than its width. What is its area in square metres?
If today is Wednesday, what day of the week will it be 100 days from now?
